'''Yveltal Steals''' (Japanese: '''イベルタル、奪う''' ''Yveltal, Take'') is the 590th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 42nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
[[Xerxer]] continues battling {{p|Yveltal}} as {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Blue}} and {{adv|X}} watch on with both their Charizard, with Yveltal using {{m|Oblivion Wing}} and {{m|Phantom Force}} to attack Xerxer with increasing ferocity. As the group debates helping Xerxer to swing the battle in its favor, Xerxer telepathically reminds them that their priority is to head to [[Pokémon Village]] and stop the [[ultimate weapon]] from being activated again. Y volunteers to stay behind with Trevor to regroup with {{adv|Shauna}} and {{adv|Tierno}}, and Blue states that he sneaked [[Diantha]] out of the battle with [[Xerosic]] so she can also head to the Village. However, as the two Charizard wielders fly off, it turns out that Diantha has already been cornered by [[Malva]], who has her {{p|Talonflame}} strike Diantha with its wings to finish her off.

As Blue and X fly over [[Snowbelle City]] towards Pokémon Village, X considers the information at hand: while Xerxer and Yveltal are fighting harder than ever, {{adv|Zygarde}} hasn't shown up in response to their battle despite [[Team Flare]] claiming no knowledge of its capture. The two of them reach the Village to find it deserted, only to be suddenly attacked by {{adv|Mewtwo}}, who Blue recognizes. Despite this, Mewtwo is in an intense rage and refuses to heed Blue's calls, sending the two Trainers flying back with {{m|Psywave}}. [[Lysandre]] arrives on the scene, gloating that Mewtwo has decided to deal with his enemies instead, revealing that Mewtwo is the guardian of Pokémon Village who hid itself away until a night prior. Blue concludes that Team Flare kidnapped the village Pokémon to power the ultimate weapon, which Lysandre doesn't deny, and calls for the boys to put up a good fight with Mewtwo so he can capture it after it's been weakened. As if in response to this, Mewtwo releases a barrage of {{m|Psystrike}} into the air, but redirects the attack at the last minute to hit Lysandre and his {{p|Gyarados}} instead. As Lysandre scowls, Mewtwo suddenly [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolves]] into Mega Mewtwo Y, causing Blue and Lysandre to realize that the Trainer responsible must be nearby. Recognizing this, Lysandre produces a remote control and activates it.

At his house in [[Camphrier Town]], [[Cassius]] and his gang realize that [[Emma]] accessed her [[Pokémon Storage System|Pokémon Storage]] a few days prior at {{rt|22|Kalos}}, prompting them to head out to search for her. As Mewtwo fights all of Lysandre's Pokémon at once, Zygarde suddenly emerges from the ground with a terrific upheaval.

==Major events==
* [[Xerxer]] continues its battle against {{p|Yveltal}}.
* {{adv|Y}} and {{adv|Trevor}} decide to stay behind and help {{adv|Tierno}} and {{adv|Shauna}} while {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Blue}} head to the [[Pokémon Village]].
* [[Diantha]] is revealed to have awakened, but is intercepted by [[Malva]].
* X and Blue arrive at the village, but are attacked by {{adv|Mewtwo}}.
* [[Lysandre]] appears and reveals that Mewtwo is the protector of the Pokémon Village.
* Mewtwo [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolves]] into Mega Mewtwo Y.
* Blue notices another person in the distance who was responsible for Mega Evolving Mewtwo.
* Lysandre uses a device to summon {{adv|Zygarde}}.
